description: Place an order intent for one to ten records (quantity, delivery market, optional date and note, the buyer's organisation and email). The Bourse routes it to each maker; verified makers answer with offers, and a maker's own Brand Agent address comes back with the routing. The email stays private: it is the buyer's key to read offers and accept one.

quantity.description: quantity with its unit, e.g. 600 bottles (75 cl)

name: create_order_intent
